sentences.en: The task is so difficult that I cannot accomplish it.
sentences.zh: 这个任务太难了，我无法完成它。

sentences.en: If you try and do everything, you'll never accomplish anything.
sentences.zh: 如果你什么都想做，那你永远都无法做成任何事情。

sentences.en: Come what may, I am determined to accomplish it.
sentences.zh: 不管发生什么，我都决心要把它做成。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：ac+compl（看作complete，完成）+ish（使…）→完成
